items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He was in a club when Jack "Legs" Diamond killed another gangster.

ctx.x: That's the Wilkins that you hear some (?) people talk about of that particular time. Well, Steele(?) worked there, and he tells me that. So he was in the... what's it's name seat... The Hot Seat? No, not the Hot Seat. I'll get the name of the club. He was in a club when Jack "Legs" Diamond killed another gangster. He was on the stand. And the last thing they saw when the guy was going out, they saw Steele(?) lookin' at 'em. When they shot the gangster and they were going out, the gangsters looked around and they…
